```{r identifier-setup}
# Expected shapes by identifier kind (9 = digit, A = letter)
kind <- fcase(grepl("EIN", v), "EIN", grepl("PTIN", v), "PTIN", grepl("PHONE", v), "Phone",
              grepl("ZIP", v), "ZIP", grepl("CUSIP", v), "CUSIP", grepl("SSN", v), "SSN",
              default = "Identifier")
expected <- list(EIN = "^999999999$", PTIN = "^A99999999$", Phone = "^9999999999$",
                 ZIP = "^(99999|999999999|99999-9999)$", SSN = "^999999999$", CUSIP = "^[9A]{9}$",
                 Identifier = ".")[[kind]]
shp <- merge(ev$shapes[xpath %in% xp$xpath], sm, by = "xpath")
shp[, ok := grepl(expected, shape)]
conf <- shp[, .(share_ok = sum(n_filings[ok]) / sum(n_filings), n = sum(n_filings)), by = .(tax_year, series)]

checks <- as.data.frame(value_checks(xp, st, ev$values[xpath %in% xp$xpath], ev$shapes[xpath %in% xp$xpath], rtype, skip_year = partial_year(ev$filings)))[, c("check", "result", "detail")]
lz <- st[!is.na(q01) & q01 < 10^(nchar(gsub("[^9]", "", sub("^\\^", "", expected))) - 1), .N] > 0
checks <- rbind(checks, data.frame(
  check = "Leading zeros present", result = if (lz) "info" else "pass",
  detail = if (lz) "at least 1% of values start with 0 in some year, so numeric storage would change them" else "no evidence of leading zeros"))
check_table(checks)
```

```{r identifier-plot, fig.height = 3.2}
if (nrow(conf)) {
  p <- ggplot(conf, aes(tax_year, share_ok, colour = series)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) + geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    scale_series("colour") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2009, 2024, 3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title = sprintf("Share of values in the expected %s format", kind), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_report()
  print(p)
}
html_table(shp[, .(Filings = sum(n_filings)), by = .(Series = series, Shape = shape, Expected = fifelse(ok, "yes", "no"))][order(Series, -Filings)],
           caption = "Value shapes (9 = digit, A = letter)")
checklist <- c(
  "The data type is text so leading zeros and letters survive.",
  "The identifier belongs to the entity the variable names (the filer, preparer, related organization...).",
  "Formats with and without punctuation (e.g. ZIP+4, dashes) are normalized consistently downstream."
)
```
